faqLead: Common questions from business owners and entrepreneurs in Vancouver, across Canada and the USA, and in Europe evaluating AI adoption.
faq1Q: What does an AI transformation consultant actually do?
faq1A: We audit your operations to find the highest-ROI AI use cases, then design and build the AI agents, LLM integrations, or automations that deliver them.
faq2Q: How do I know if my business is ready for AI?
faq2A: If you have repeatable manual workflows, unstructured data, or predictable customer questions, you are ready. We confirm readiness with a fixed-scope audit first.
faq3Q: How is this different from just using ChatGPT or Copilot?
faq3A: Off-the-shelf tools help one person at a time. We integrate AI into your systems and data, with security and governance, so the whole business benefits.
faq4Q: Do you build custom AI agents, or only advise on strategy?
faq4A: Both. We deliver the strategy and audit, and our senior engineering team builds and ships the AI agents, RAG systems, and integrations.
faq5Q: How much does an AI transformation engagement cost?
faq5A: Engagements typically start with a fixed-scope AI Readiness Audit, followed by phased implementation priced by scope. You get a clear estimate before build starts.
faq6Q: Can you add AI to our existing software instead of rebuilding?
faq6A: Yes. Most engagements add AI capabilities to systems you already run, rather than replacing them, which minimizes risk and time to value.
faq7Q: Do you work with small businesses, or only large enterprises?
faq7A: Both. Our engineering discipline was built delivering mission-critical systems for global enterprises, and we apply that same rigor to growing businesses.
faq8Q: Which regions do you serve for AI consulting?
faq8A: Vancouver and Canada, the United States including San Francisco, Texas, and Chicago, and Europe including Germany, Italy, and Spain, remote-first everywhere.
